```{r getdat, eval=FALSE}

# run the script that reads the advice sheets to fill out the slides and save the dataset

source(here::here("Projects/ICES_ACOM/NWWAC/R/ReadAdviceSheet_Fig1Title.R"))

files <- list.files("~/Documents/Work/ICES-ACOM/AdviceSheets/Elasmobranchs2026", pattern = "\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE)
all_results <- purrr::map(files, purrr::possibly(extract_ices_advice, otherwise = NULL, quiet = FALSE)) |>
  purrr::list_rbind()

saveRDS(all_results, here::here("Projects/ICES_ACOM/NWWAC/advicedat/2026_elasmos.rds"))

# Introduction

Focus on advice released in autumn 2026

```{r}
all_results |> dplyr::select(title, stock_code) |>
  dplyr::arrange(factor(stock_code, levels = c("rjc.27.6",
                                               "rjc.27.7afg",
                                               "rje.27.7fg",
                                               "rjm.27.67bj",
                                               "rjm.27.7ae-h",
                                               "rjn.27.678abd",
                                               "rju.27.7de",
                                               "por.27.nea", 
                                               "dgs.27.nea"))) |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::autofit() |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(title = "Stock name", stock_code = "Stock code")

```

--

* UK 2018 to 2023 commercial landings and discards updates for rjc.27.7afg, rje.27.7fg, rjh.27.7afg included

---
## Introduction

Follow-ups from WKSKATE2 noted
* Blond ray 7.e exploratory work conducted, requires further discussion – but not assessed this year
* Thornback ray 7.e preliminary work may lead to a new model based index in the 2028 assessment – not assessed this year
* Thornback ray in divisions 7.a and 7.f–g revised length for exploitable B (30 instead of 50 cm), reference levels recalculated – discard survival included
* Spotted ray in 6 7.b 7.j included a new survey index, reference levels recalculated
* Spotted ray in divisions 7.a and 7.e–h  revised length for exploitable B (30 instead of 50 cm), reference levels recalculated – discard survival included
* Small-eyed ray in divisions 7.f and 7.g  revised length for exploitable B (30 instead of 50 cm), reference levels recalculated – discard survival included
* Common skate complex potential to split into common blue skate and flapper skate for future assessments – but not assessed this year

--

Update on Spurdog (*Squalus acanthias*)

--

Brief review of multiannual advice released previously

    "background-image: url(\"https://github.com/sgaichas/HSpresentations/raw/main/{{ st$figure_png }}\")",
    "background-size: 900px",
    "background-position: bottom 30px left -20px",
    "## {{ st$title }}",

    ".pull-left-70[",
    "",
    "",
    ".footnote[ {{ st$advice_url }}]",
    "]",
    "",
    ".pull-right-30[",
    "{{ st$fishing_pressure }}",
    "",
    "{{ st$stock_size }}",
    "",
    "{{ st$advice_change_note }}",
    "",
    "]",
    "---",
    "## {{ st$title }}",
    "",
    ".pull-left-30[",
    "Total landings ({{ st$catch_year }}):  {{ st$landings_t }} t, {{ st$catch_dist_note }}",
    "",
    ".footnote[ {{ st$advice_url }}]",
    "]",
    ".pull-right-70[",
    "```{r}",
    "#| echo: false",

    "Btot (2026): 679893 t; {{ st$forecast_values[[1]]$variable[2] }}: {{ st$forecast_values[[1]]$value[2] }} t ; {{ st$reference_points[[1]]$reference_point[2] }}: {{ st$reference_points[[1]]$value_num[2] }} t and {{ st$reference_points[[1]]$reference_point[3] }}: {{ st$reference_points[[1]]$value_num[3] }} t",
    "",
    "```{r}",
    "#| echo: false",
    "st_scen |>",
    "dplyr::select(!c(1:4)) |>",
    "dplyr::rename_all(function(x) gsub(\"_\", \" \", x)) |>",
    "flextable::flextable() |>",
    "flextable::autofit()",
    "```",
    "",
    ".footnote[ {{ st$advice_url }}]",
    "---"))
res <- knitr::knit_child(text = src, quiet = TRUE)
cat(res, sep = '\n')
```

### Previously released plus current advice

```{r eval=FALSE}
source(here::here("Projects/ICES_ACOM/NWWAC/R/ReadAdviceSheet_Fig1Title.R"))

files <- list.files("~/Documents/Work/ICES-ACOM/AdviceSheets/Elasmobranchs", pattern = "\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE)
allyr_results <- purrr::map(files, purrr::possibly(extract_ices_advice, otherwise = NULL, quiet = FALSE)) |>
  purrr::list_rbind()

saveRDS(allyr_results, here::here("Projects/ICES_ACOM/NWWAC/advicedat/allcurrent_elasmos.rds"))
```

```{r}

allyr_results <- readRDS(here::here("advicedat/allcurrent_elasmos.rds"))

advicesum <- allyr_results |> dplyr::select(stock_code, title, catch_advice) |> tidyr::unnest(catch_advice) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(stock_code)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(stock_code, title) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = advice_t) |>
  dplyr::select(stock_code, title, advice_type, `2025`, `2026`,`2027`,`2028`,`2030`) |>
  dplyr::mutate(`2029` = NA) |>
  dplyr::select(stock_code, title, advice_type, `2025`, `2026`,`2027`,`2028`,`2029`, `2030`) 

# remove NA all years
advicesum <- advicesum[-c(3:4, 20),]

# fill 4 year series
#porbeagle
advicesum[2,c(7:8)] <- 185
# thornback 7e
advicesum[7,c(5:6)] <- 170
# smalleye
advicesum[8,c(5:6)] <- 32

advicesum[10,c(5:6)] <- 134

advicesum[11,c(5:6)] <- 573

advicesum[12,c(5:6)] <- 213

advicesum[13,c(5:6)] <- 27

#remove duplicate catch/landings
advicesum <- advicesum[-4,]

advicesum <- advicesum[-18,]

flextable::flextable(advicesum) |>
  flextable::fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit() |>
  flextable::padding(padding.top = 1, part = "all") |>
  flextable::padding(padding.bottom = 1, part = "all")


```
